change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Monitor context sends the raw config, not the copy with the readable schedule_type
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies the config and swaps `schedule_type` for its display value (lines 160-162). Line 168 then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config`, the original, so the copy is thrown away and the event's monitor context still holds the integer `schedule_type`. This bug was already in `mark_failed.py` and was moved here unchanged. Since this PR is reorganizing the code anyway, consider returning `config` here, which is what `MonitorSerializer.serialize` does at src/sentry/monitors/serializers.py:240-242. Any test that asserts the current context shape would need updating.

findings.title: get_failure_reason docstring has typos and examples the function cannot produce
findings.body: The moved docstring says "humam readible". Its examples don't match the code either. The plural branch returns "... check-ins detected" (line 156), never "... were detected", and builds parts like "2 missed" rather than "2 missed check-ins". The singular branch uses `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP`, which has no "A failed check-in was detected" entry. Consider fixing the docstring now that the function lives in its own module.

contracts.action: mark_failed now delegates to try_incident_threshold (moved from mark_failed_threshold)
contracts.equivalent_path: Old mark_failed_threshold in mark_failed.py, moved verbatim to incidents.py
contracts.before_after: Same arguments (failed_checkin, failure_issue_threshold, received) and the same return value. The body of try_incident_threshold is the old body with create_issue_platform_occurrence renamed to create_incident_occurrence.
contracts.visible_effect: No change: the same MonitorEnvironment status update, MonitorIncident get_or_create, occurrence produced to Kafka, and monitor_environment_failed signal.
contracts.failure_mode: Unchanged from before. produce_occurrence_to_kafka is still imported inside the function from sentry.issues.producer, so tests that patch sentry.issues.producer.produce_occurrence_to_kafka still intercept it. Nothing outside these modules imported the moved names from mark_failed.

contracts.action: Loop that creates one occurrence per previous check-in
contracts.equivalent_path: The same loop in the old mark_failed_threshold
contracts.before_after: Bounded by failure_issue_threshold, since previous_checkins is sliced to the threshold, or by 1 in the ERROR branch. The calls are synchronous Kafka produces with no retry loop in this code.

summary: This PR is a straight move. The incident-threshold logic goes to `logic/incidents.py`, occurrence creation goes to `logic/incident_occurrence.py`, and `SimpleCheckIn` goes to `types.py`. Behavior is unchanged, and nothing in the repository imported the moved names from `mark_failed`. Test patches that target `sentry.issues.producer.produce_occurrence_to_kafka` still work, because the import still happens inside the function. There are two optional suggestions on the moved code: a dead config copy in `get_monitor_environment_context` that was already there before the move, and an inaccurate docstring on `get_failure_reason`.
